english: Medals from the / floor boss were / offered to the gods.
At the Guild, many / sought to form / parties together.
Amid the bustle, / armored knights / caught the eye.
They addressed / the gathered / adventurers.
Knight: Proud / adventurers, / my friends!
Knight: The party / of Regina Eranshika / is missing!
Knight: Last seen / on the 2nd floor / of the labyrinth!
Knight: Will anyone / investigate their / whereabouts?
Despite the appeal, / the crowd responded / in a curt manner.
Adv. A: We have our / own wounded! / Adv. B: I heard more.
Adv. C: They got the / cushy jobs! / Adv. A: Hmph! Unfair!
The knights watched / the adventurers / react for a while,
but finally gave up / and walked away.
As they left, / their leader / grumbled bitterly.
Commander: This is / Webster's mess! / Knight: Sir, shh!
Commander: Belgrano! / Hmm? I haven't seen / your face before.
The knight stared / at you as if he was / sizing you up.
You must be a new / adventurer.
Currently, Duhan / welcomes those who / are skilled.
What do you think? / Will you help us / with our request?
The strike force / has vanished on / the labyrinth's 2F.
I'd send a search / party, but I lack / the manpower.
If you could look / into it, that would / help greatly.
Pardon me. I am / Belgrano von Buren, / Order commander.
Oh, uhm...! / May I also go to / the labyrinth?
The woman you had / met earlier at the / temple approached.
Belgrano: Do nuns / also go to the / labyrinth nowadays?
Erika: Yes, I was / hoping I could be / of some help!
The knights found / the nun's calm words / oddly out of place.
I appreciate that, / but you don't even / have companions.
In the labyrinth, / preparation and calm / outweigh raw courage.
If you plan to go, / find companions / here at the Guild.
Belgrano spoke to / both you and / Erika.
If you're willing, / why not visit the / labyrinth?
Belgrano instructed / his men, then left / the Guild.
Uhm, are you also / looking for / companions?
If you don't mind, / would you let me / join your party?
I've heard the Guild / is where leaders / find companions.
It's embarrassing, / but I'm not used to / giving orders...!
And I don't know / anything about / fighting either...!
Everyone would / scold me for going / unprepared.
But I must act...! / I can't stay idle / in this city.
Please, would you / lend me your / strength?
Erika wants to / join your party. /  / Accept her / Refuse
I'm so glad...! / What would I do / if you refused?
I'm looking forward / to working with / you.
Erika has joined / your party.
I see, that's a / shame...!
But perhaps this is / one of the trials / that God gave me.
I will try to do it / by myself without / help from others.
Thank you for / showing me the way.
Where the hell did / that scallywag / run off to!?
In the Guild's din, / a loud raspy voice / reached your ears.
A giant of a man / waded through the / crowd, searching.
The huge man saw / you near the door / and stomped over.
Hey, you there!
Hey, you there!
Giant Man: I've got / a question for you, / if that's okay?
Before you stood / a hulking man, well / over 150 kilos.
Sharp blade-eyes, / scarred face, shaved / head, bull neck.
The man clicked his / tongue loudly.
That bastard has me / running around in / this damn cold!
He's really getting / on my nerves, / that bastard!!
The man wiped sweat / from his brow as he / caught his breath.
Oh, yeah, there's / something I want / to ask you...!
Seen a tattooed / bastard around here? / Short, strange hat.
Height? Average. / Pretty ordinary / for a human.
He wears a strange / hat, so you'd know / him at first sight.
Seen a man with / a strange hat? /  / Seen him / Know nothing
So that bastard / is still lurking / around here...!
Thanks, that saves / me a lot of / trouble.
Hey, it's not much, / but take this!
The man pulled out / a gorgeous wallet / from his pocket.
You received / 1000G.
I see, then I've / got nothing.
The giant sighed / and began to grumble / for all to hear.
I threw the bastard / into the labyrinth / to hunt the witch!
But he came back / looking cowardly, / ready to flee town.
How dare he run off / during this damned / personnel crisis!
I just yelled a bit / and he left his / resignation letter!
Can you believe it? / He wants his / pension too!
If I find him, / I'll gut him and / toss him in the canal!
Hey, sorry to / bother you. / Farewell!
The giant stopped, / as if recalling / something.
If you see that / Turgot bastard, / tell him this:
Duhan's life is at / stake! No city, no / pension! Tell him!
Well then, goodbye!
The man raised a / pudgy finger, gave / a salute, and left.
